name: claude-code-mods
description: Small mods for the Claude Code terminal UI: a usage meter and a working critter.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Session (5h) and weekly usage bars above the prompt, with a /limits pane for pace and reset details.

plugins.name: working-critter
plugins.description: A tiny pixel crew runs at the top-right corner while Claude is working: one critter per agent, plus background shells and monitors.
